entities.summary: The Abdulla Bin Zaid Al Mahmoud Islamic Cultural Center, commonly known simply as Bin Zaid, and also known previously as Fanar or Qatar Islamic Culture Center and Spiral Mosque, is a mosque and cultural center, located in Doha Municipaltiy, in Doha, the capital of Qatar. It is located close to Doha Corniche and is a prominent landmark in the city. Abdulla Bin Zaid Al Mahmoud Islamic Cultural Center is a mosque in Asia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
